category: self-hosted workflow automation software (n8n Community Edition)

free_tier.stated: The free Community edition: what n8n runs without a license key, with almost the complete feature set of n8n, installed and run by the user on a machine of their own; registering an email address for a free license key unlocks folders, debug in editor and custom execution data
free_tier.notes: n8n's documentation scopes the execution quota to paid plans, cloud or self-hosted, and the Community edition is not a paid plan. The hosted 14-day Cloud trial is dev-services/n8n-cloud and comes first.

per_object_cap.stated: 16 MiB maximum payload by default (N8N_PAYLOAD_SIZE_MAX), raised by setting the variable higher; 200 MiB for files in form-data webhook payloads by default (N8N_FORMDATA_FILE_SIZE_MAX)
per_object_cap.notes: both values are defaults that the user changes with an environment variable

retention.stated: saved executions are deleted on a rolling basis by default, after 336 hours (14 days) or beyond 10000 stored executions; the user changes both settings with environment variables
retention.notes: EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE, EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE and EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE_MAX_COUNT; 336 hours / 24 = 14 days

egress.terms: not set by the software: workflows call third-party APIs from the machine the user runs n8n on, so that host's network terms apply

interface_detail: the n8n public REST API is available on all self-hosted editions, and the n8n CLI wraps that API; workflows are also built in the web editor
tooling: the user installs and runs n8n on a rented or free machine: the one-line setup script (curl -fsSL https://get.n8n.io | sh) or a Docker Compose setup, with the built-in SQLite database or Postgres; the web editor, the public REST API and the n8n CLI. From n8n 3.0, n8n is only distributed through Docker.
chaining: Last resort after the hosted workflow offers (the 14-day n8n Cloud trial in dev-services/n8n-cloud, and the hosted free tiers of Pipedream, Zapier and Inngest): triggers, schedules and integrations run on a machine that the user installs and keeps running.

limits.value: 16 MiB payload size by default, raised with N8N_PAYLOAD_SIZE_MAX
saved executions are pruned by default after 336 hours (14 days) or beyond 10000 stored executions

limits_note: The Community edition omits paid features such as SSO, environments, external secrets and log streaming. The Docker Compose setup needs at least 4 GB of RAM and 2 vCPUs. The default execution timeout is disabled (-1), and users can set up to 3600 seconds for an individual workflow.
binding_note: The documentation states no quota for the Community edition; the machine that runs it bounds throughput, and the pruning and payload defaults are environment variables that the user changes.

identity_cost.detail: No account with n8n is needed to install and run the Community edition: the one-line setup and Docker Compose pages ask for none, and the account is created on the user's own instance at its initial account creation. Registering that instance with an email address is optional and sends a free license key.

reliability_note: The user provides, maintains and keeps running the infrastructure; saved executions are pruned by default after 14 days; from n8n 3.0 n8n is distributed only through Docker and npm installs are deprecated.
confidence_note: Editions, install paths, the public API, the pruning and payload defaults and the excluded features are read on first-party documentation pages; the installation was not run, and no execution quota for the Community edition is stated on those pages.
